sources.scope: Author's own operational reconstruction and worked vector, pages 2-3 and 7-10. Not a historical physical-machine KAT.
observations: Outer plaintext alphabet has A-Z plus space; inner is a permutation of A-Z.
Hands move equal symbol steps clockwise, 27/26 angular ratio.
Repeated plaintext letter replacement and optional enciphered terminal space are explicit.
MEQT_AT_DAWN_ with the published key produces GNKJMZWZCBAIN.

observations: Repeated plaintext must be disguised for reversible decoding.
Spaces emit ciphertext; pointer advancement does not include discretionary extra revolutions.
A second worked vector uses SECRET_MESXSAGE_ and yields YEQORNCXFLHMRVGA.
Pletts' mixed-plaintext-ring extension is described, but no complete independent physical Plett validation is claimed here.

prior_coverage.covered: Finite generated outer alphabets with all blank slots and reversals, arbitrary inner permutation and free inter-island phase. No prior dictionary sweep rerun or extra negative count.
prior_coverage.gap_closed: Invariant verifies impossibility for arbitrary fixed outer/inner permutations under aligned processed-text, fixed-transition assumptions.
prior_coverage.not_covered: State-dependent moves, changing rings, hidden operations, unknown preprocessing/alignment and full authentic Plett/Wadsworth conventions.
